source: Musai design, 'Status' step three (scopes neither of which contains the other count as equal) generalised to three candidates
description: three supporting arguments at three distinct, mutually incomparable point scopes, equal evidence kind and equal weight
reasoning: a point scope contains only its own value, so three distinct points are pairwise incomparable; with evidence kind and weight tied too, no argument beats any other, and since all three support the claim they corroborate it: the claim holds, led by the first in id order and beating none of the others, never open as though they disagreed
